name: linux_triage
description: Parse a Linux disk image or extracted root with dissect.target, one function at a time, including E01 images whose root is inside LVM. The complete output of each family's functions is kept under out_dir (JSON Lines, or text for the identity family) with each function's stderr in a file of its own; the inline answer is a manifest with no evidence text in it. The family files are bulk extracts of evidence text (histories, authentication lines, journal entries, container logs) and can hold secrets: they are not sealed as sensitive unless the job ran with secret_output. Each function gets the status it earned and the evidence for it: parsed (exit 0, records), empty (exit 0, nothing, no stderr), unsupported (exit 0, nothing, and a stderr line that names the function and says it is not available: the message patterns are not validated against dissect.target, so a message that does not name the function, or does not match, leaves it `unknown`), failed (non-zero exit or a deadline), not_attempted (the total deadline), unknown (a line that is not JSON, a stderr that names no cause for an empty result, or a traceback beside records). execution_complete says every function was started and exited 0 within its deadline; it is not artefact coverage, and neither is `parsed`: the counts under coverage are what each function produced, not what the host held. Each family names its functions and what they do not cover (sessions: classic wtmp/btmp/lastlog only; history: bash only; packages: dpkg.status and package-manager logs, no RPM; containers: container.logs only; there is no audit family). Empty output is a parser's result, not proof the artefact is absent. timeout_seconds is per function (default 1800) and total_timeout_seconds covers the run (default 13800, under this manifest's 14400); summary.json in out_dir is rewritten after every function, and a SIGTERM ends the function that is running and says terminated, so a run stopped from outside leaves what it had done. groups omitted runs every family; an empty list, an unknown name or a repeated one is refused. Accepts an image (extensions and magic in `use`) or a directory holding an extracted root; whether a given function reads an extracted root is shown by its status, not assumed.

source.description: An E01/raw/VM disk image or extracted Linux root

out_dir.description: A new directory under work/ or the job output for the complete results; refused if it exists

groups.description: Families to run: identity, users, sessions, authentication, history, persistence, packages, ssh, logs, web, containers. Omit it to run all of them; an empty list, an unknown family or a repeated one is refused

total_timeout_seconds.description: Deadline for the whole run (default 13800). A function is not started with less than a second left, and one that runs into it is failed with deadline: total; the rest are not_attempted
